CN health & beauty salon Personal Information Protection Policy

CN health & beauty salon (hereinafter, the "Salon"), operated by CN Wing Kikaku Co., Ltd. (CNウィング企画株式会社), recognizes the importance of the personal information of its customers (hereinafter, "Users"), complies with the Act on the Protection of Personal Information (hereinafter, the "Personal Information Protection Act") and other relevant laws, regulations, and guidelines, has established the following privacy policy (hereinafter, this "Policy"), and shall endeavor to handle and protect personal information appropriately.

This Policy shall apply to the handling of Users' personal information acquired by the Salon in the CN health & beauty salon Online Booking Service provided by the Salon, in-store treatments and product sales, and all other services provided by the Salon (hereinafter collectively, the "Services").

In this Policy, "personal information" means personal information as defined in Article 2, Paragraph 1 of the Personal Information Protection Act, that is, information relating to a living individual that can identify a specific individual by the name, date of birth, or other descriptions, etc. contained in such information (including information that can be readily collated with other information and thereby identify a specific individual), or that contains an individual identification code.
Chapter 2 Acquisition and Use of Personal Information
In providing the Services, the Salon may acquire the following personal information by appropriate means:
(1) Name, phonetic reading of name (furigana), gender, and date of birth
(2) Address, telephone number, and email address
(3) Booking date and time, date and time of visit, treatment details, products purchased, payment amount, and payment method
(4) Information entered on the counseling sheet (skin type, constitution, requests, etc.)
(5) Photographs taken before and after treatment (only where the User's consent has been obtained)
(6) Usage history of the online booking service, access logs, and device information such as cookies
(7) Information voluntarily provided by Users in inquiries, surveys, etc.
Article 4 (Handling of Information on Health Conditions, etc.)

1. In order to perform treatments safely and appropriately, the Salon may ask Users for information such as their health conditions, medical history, whether they have any allergies, whether they are pregnant, and their medication status (hereinafter, "Health Information, etc.").

2. Of the Health Information, etc., any information that constitutes special care-required personal information as defined in the Personal Information Protection Act shall be acquired only after obtaining the User's prior consent, and shall not be used for any purpose other than determining whether a treatment can be performed and providing safe treatments.
The Salon shall use the personal information it acquires within the scope of the following purposes:
(1) Accepting, confirming, changing, and canceling bookings, and communicating with Users regarding the same
(2) Providing treatments, counseling, and other Services
(3) Billing, payment processing, and settlement of payment processing fees
(4) Managing treatment history and proposing better services for subsequent visits
(5) Providing information on new menus, campaigns, events, etc. (by email, SMS, postal mail, etc.)
(7) Conducting surveys and preparing statistical data for service improvement (limited to data processed into a form that does not identify individuals)
(8) Responding to acts that violate the Terms of Use, cancellations without notice (no-shows), etc.
(9) Other purposes incidental to the purposes listed in the items above
Chapter 3 Management and Provision of Personal Information

The Salon shall take necessary and appropriate measures for the prevention of leakage, loss, or damage of personal information and for other security control, such as training and supervising employees, managing access rights, storing paper media under lock and key, and setting passwords.
The Salon shall not provide personal information to any third party without obtaining the User's prior consent, except in any of the following cases:
(1) Where based on laws and regulations
(2) Where it is necessary for the protection of the life, body, or property of an individual and it is difficult to obtain the User's consent
(3) Where it is especially necessary for improving public health or promoting the sound growth of children and it is difficult to obtain the User's consent

(4) Where it is necessary to cooperate with a national government agency, a local government, or a person entrusted by either of them in performing affairs prescribed by laws and regulations, and obtaining the User's consent is likely to impede the performance of such affairs

To the extent necessary to achieve the purposes of use, the Salon may outsource all or part of its operations, such as operation of the booking system, payment processing, and email delivery, to external business operators. In such cases, the Salon shall exercise necessary and appropriate supervision over the contractors so that personal information is properly managed by them.

Payment information, such as card numbers, relating to payments made by methods other than cash, such as credit cards, electronic money, and QR code payments, shall be directly acquired and managed by the respective payment processing companies, and the Salon shall not retain such information.
